class.name: NNBTSequenceStar
class.brief_description: A sequence with memory that resumes at the failed or interrupted child instead of restarting from the first child.
class.description: Works like [NNBTSequence], except it remembers which child failed or was interrupted and resumes there on the next run so already-completed steps are not repeated. The memory resets once all children succeed, or when the node is reset or disabled. Use this for multi-step routines where earlier steps should not re-run after an interruption. Setting [member NNBTSequence.reactive] to [code]true[/code] overrides this memory and restarts from child 0 every tick.
